title: Madam Secretary (TV series)
premise_summary: Madam Secretary is an American political drama television series created by Barbara Hall, with Morgan Freeman and Lori McCreary as executive producers. It stars Téa Leoni as Elizabeth McCord, a former CIA analyst and political science professor who is appointed as the United States secretary of state following the suspicious death of her predecessor.
